clue.text: Correct project given change of direction at the end

explanation.surface: A project needs a new heading as it nears completion.
explanation.walkthrough: PROPEL ends in L (left); changing direction turns it into R (right).
explanation.definitionFit: Proper and correct are synonyms when describing suitable, right behaviour or form.

clue.text: This writer's continuing with the unfinished story

clue.text: By the way, this safety procedure is recommended
